title: Vinidarius complete pantry-and-recipe register with quantities and alternatives
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Jointly reconstruct the complete six-block pantry list and all31 recipes in the Excerpta a Vinidario through one shared ingredient/operation/quantity lexicon. The two source genres constrain the same named ingredients. Preserve repeated mentions, alternatives and conditional additions; this is not anonymous recipe likeness or a source-letter decoder.

design.primary_source: Bibliotheca Augustana complete Latin Excerpta a Vinidario: https://www.hs-augsburg.de/~harsch/Chronologia/Lspost04/Apicius/api_exc1.html and https://www.hs-augsburg.de/~harsch/Chronologia/Lspost04/Apicius/api_exc2.html . Both full pages read. Institutional electronic edition, not independently collated original manuscript. Inventory has six written blocks; recipe capitula and bodies runI–XXXI. Modern brackets and supplements remain unresolved source variants.
design.concrete_mechanism: The source places a pantry catalogue beside31 recipes. RecipeII gives wine, fish sauce and honey weights and a milk volume;III equates an oil quantity with the preceding fish-sauce amount;XXIV specifies pepper count, onion count, liquid measures and a conditional further water addition. Recipe alternatives are explicitly written. This supplies shared ingredients, distinct quantity roles, equality links and branch operators across complete records.
design.compiler: Before targets, independently collate all six pantry blocks and31 recipe bodies into ordered typed literal-lemma mentions: ingredient including explicitly written part/state, operation verb, unit, numeral, approximate-quantity expression, alternative connective and explicit condition marker. Preserve every occurrence in these declared categories and every written quantity equality; do not infer omitted ingredients, resolve anaphora without an explicit finite source annotation, or expand conditional instructions to executed additions. Recipe titles are ordinary source mentions, never opaque unique recipe IDs. All37 projected records are obligatory. Full source-to-projection coverage receipts expose all omitted prose. This is a conceptual projection of complete records, not a claim of full Latin translation.
design.joint_model: One finite globally injective named-atom-to-whole-group lexicon, shared across pantry and recipes, and one fixed serialization explain37 distinct whole paragraphs from a separately frozen already-exposed odd panel. All selected paragraphs are projected through the same global lexical set; background status cannot vary per occurrence. Record assignment is unknown jointly with word values. Quantity numeral/unit and explicit equal-amount roles remain separate; no free numeric value per recipe. Exact all-record equality and all-solution projection are required. The target compiler and source role inventory are hypotheses, not observed manuscript structure.
design.different_decision: GDT340 tested anonymous five-event schema likeness and lacked comparator/target capacity; its primary report does not test a named whole-source pantry/recipe network. IDEA124 requires external material-container/final-inventory identity, absent here. This model instead binds identities jointly through a fixed complete source catalogue plus recipe reuse and literal quantity/alternative relations. It is not a retry of Alphita six-name incidence, Simon literal-copy channels or the music source. Source asymmetry and empirical identification must be tested rather than assumed.
design.limits: Pantry is not a complete inventory of every food or liquid used: never infer absent-ingredient prohibitions. Do not merge garum/liquamen, fresh/dry forms or ingredient parts by modern culinary intuition. An amount under a conditional branch is not an unconditional total. No conversion between different historical units without a separately fixed source rule. Single-occurrence ingredients and ambiguous lemma choices may leave names unidentified. The same global-background architecture is shared with901; source change alone is not evidence of improvement. A source-only checkpoint must show that quantity/alternative/catalogue coupling adds identifiable relations beyond plain ingredient incidence before any solver work.
design.next_step: If selected, cap complete two-reader source compilation and ambiguity/automorphism audit at30minutes; stop if the full37 records cannot be compiled without discretionary interpretation. Only then write a separate decision and target-scope contract. No target access or experimental selection occurred in this producer task. No solver repair, large control suite or source replacement is authorized by this card.

source_checkpoint.source_coverage: Both complete institutional pages reread: all six pantry blocks and31 recipes; no target. No complete semantic compiler or automorphism enumeration claimed.
source_checkpoint.new_identification_countermodel: In the unordered ingredient-incidence graph, amygdala and aballana are two distinct named pantry-only leaves in the same nuts block. Neither occurs in the31 recipe bodies or titles. Swapping those two names preserves pantry/recipe incidence and every quantity/equality/alternative/operation edge derived from those recipes. Consequently adding those edges cannot make the whole named graph rigid. Source within-block ordering could distinguish them, but then the identification uses an additional ordered-copy law, not quantitative coupling. This does not prove that the ordered full model is impossible.
source_checkpoint.quantity_audit: Numerically specified ingredient amounts occur inII,III,VI,VII,XVI,XIX,XXIII,XXIV. III has explicit same-amount wording for oil after fish sauce. XXIV includes a conditional further water dose. These are genuine potential constraints, but not a complete arithmetic program or a demonstrated identification gain.
source_checkpoint.compiler_gaps: XVI leaves the reference measure of the honey fraction implicit; XXII relies on a sauce reference rather than listing its contents. II permits unspecified available additions. Pantry catalogue is not an exhaustive food inventory. Source variants in headings and supplied words remain unresolved. A complete operational graph would therefore need declared unknowns/finite interpretations, not silently completed operands. A literal ordered mention trace is possible in principle but is a different and weaker semantic claim.
source_checkpoint.decision: Do not spend the remaining research interval on hundreds of annotations or a new fitter for this card. Quantitative augmentation has not earned the promised complete-identification distinction over source incidence/ordered copying. Preserve the raw proposal; no manuscript hypothesis refutation and no claim that all potential ingredient mappings are ambiguous. Reconsider only with a complete source-only compiler plus an explicit before/after identification result that changes selection. No replacement source is automatically authorized.
